payload.setup: Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) is a bitcoin treasury company that also sells asset-management services. This package covers the 3-month forecast from 2026-10-16 to 2027-01-15.
payload.economic_basis: The common shares receive only the value left after the 13%-15% preferred dividends are paid, and the current common share count is not stated, so the per-share economics are an estimate. The planned $500 million SATS raise and recent $84,500 bitcoin purchases raise common value only if bitcoin's return beats those preferred costs and no large common-share issue follows.
evidence: On 2026-10-15 the close was $25.635, the daily return was +3.89%, the three-month return was +107.7%, and the screen pattern was 'Up / cooling'.

Between 5 and 9 October 2026 Strive bought 3,311 bitcoin for about $280 million at roughly $84,500 per bitcoin, taking holdings to 32,773 bitcoin (https://benzinga.com/news/26/10/62320971/strive-acquires-3-311-bitcoins-average-price-84-500-bitcoin-oct-5-through-oct-9).

Strive announced a planned IPO of 5 million SATS preferred shares at $100 each to raise $500 million with a 15% dividend; the existing SATA preferred pays about 13% variable (https://benzinga.com/news/26/10/62341031/strive-plans-conduct-initial-public-offering-5m-shares-its-15-series-perpetual-sats-preferred-shares, https://coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/13/strive-to-ipo-second-preferred-share-class-as-it-looks-to-further-build-bitcoin-treasury).

forecast.pricing_assessment: The $25.635 close follows a 107.7% three-month gain, but that past gain does not tell me what expectations are already embedded in the price. I call the shares long because the planned preferred raise and recent bitcoin purchases create a visible path to higher bitcoin value per common share if bitcoin rises and the raise completes.
assumptions: Bitcoin remains above Strive's recent $84,500 average purchase price through the three-month horizon.
The SATS preferred offering completes at or near the stated terms and the proceeds buy bitcoin or repurchase common shares.
No large common-share issuance offsets the preferred-funded purchases.
forecast.opposing_case: The preferred shares rank ahead of common and pay 13%-15% cash dividends. If bitcoin stays flat or falls, those dividends and preferred claims leave less value for common holders, and the August 2026 window showed a 5.5% holding gain but only a 1.3% gain per diluted share.

calls.hypothesis: From 2026-10-16 through 2027-01-15, ASST common shares rise because the planned SATS raise and further bitcoin purchases add bitcoin value behind each common share. The share price climbs above $25.635 as investors pay for that larger bitcoin-per-share value.
calls.invalidation: The thesis fails if Strive cancels or materially reduces the SATS offering. It also fails if bitcoin falls below the $84,500 average purchase cost and stays lower, because the funding and treasury value both weaken.
tail_risks: Bitcoin falls below the recent $84,500 average purchase price and stays lower through January 2027.
The SATS offering is withdrawn or repriced with a higher dividend, increasing the cash cost before common holders get value.
A large new common-share sale dilutes bitcoin per common share.
evidence_limits: Get the current diluted common share count and preferred obligations after the SATS raise.
Learn the source of the cash used for the October bitcoin purchases because debt or hidden senior claims would reduce common value.
Track whether the SATS proceeds actually buy bitcoin or repurchase common shares rather than being held as cash.
